en.html:
That, more or less, was the content that Captain Ootori, back from Yokohama, had given the Chief in writing and repeated aloud.

For a while there were no words. The others seemed to be the same. Only the sound of the Chief's fingertips turning the pages disturbed the stillness settled in the air.

A top-secret Rokuhara weapons experiment.

Considering present conditions, it was certainly not an impossible story. And yet—

Kanae"'I saw a silver monster'? We are not writing a horror novel, na. A professional investigator, and this is the report he sends?"
Kageaki"I too think it is excessively lyrical."
Kanae"And then a weapons experiment, and a request for police cooperation. ...Well, taken separately, neither is particularly suspicious."
Kageaki"Yes."
Kanae"Put them together, though, and the sense goes missing. For an investigation highly confidential even for the investigators themselves, outside help they want?"
Kageaki"The explanation given was a shortage of suitable personnel, but..."
Kanae"Since wartime the League has had plenty of local agents. Today how things stand, I cannot claim to know... But this 'shortage of manpower,' somehow I cannot make myself believe it."

Kageaki"Let me ask frankly, Captain: have you been given some other explanation about this matter?"
Kanae"Nothing at all. Such an urgent summons—what has happened, I wonder, and off to Yokohama I go. There, this bundle of paper they put in my hands. Finished."
Kanae"Apparently my superior has yet to discover this system called the mail. What a difficulty."
Sayo"For classified information, naturally the proper procedure. Naturally also, a ridiculous business, miss."
Kageaki"...They request the Police Bureau to cooperate in investigating Rokuhara weapons research. That premise needs them to regard the shogunate and the Police Bureau as separate. How is that point handled?"
Kanae"I have already reported the friendship between His Highness Prince Maidono and the Chief of Kamakura Station, and that both of them grieve over the present state of Yamato."

en.html:
舞殿宮"So they have gone and set a trap, is it?"
Chief"Yes. Whatever awaits on Enoshima, we can safely assume its aim is to capture and kill Kageaki."
Chief"Your opinion, Captain?"
Kanae"Entirely agreed. Since I heard this story, the hair at the back of my neck simply will not lie down. Every last one, standing to attention."
Kanae"Here, Kageaki. Please inspect for yourself."
Kageaki"Ji?"
Sayo"Such indecorum, miss."
舞殿宮"I-indecorum?! Something indecorous is going on!? Arre, yeh parda! This blind is in the way, I cannot see a thing!"
Kanae"Kageaki... you may feel the hair too, you know?"
Kageaki"Then, with your permission."
Chief"...Later. If the Captain has no objection either, there is no obstacle to concluding that this affair is a trap."
Chief"Either we decline, choosing our words carefully, or we accept on the surface and do nothing in substance—in short, settle on sabotage. One of the two would be fitting, I submit, Your Highness."
舞殿宮"Hmm, true. Kageaki, you are fine with this, no?"
Kageaki"No."
舞殿宮"Ouch!?"
Chief"...Kageaki."
Kageaki"I will go to Enoshima. Your Highness, kindly issue the secret order for my bail."
Kanae"A secret... bail order?"
Kageaki"There is some delicacy involved. Please let it pass out of your hearing."
Kanae"Understood♪"
Sayo"Show how obedient you are, collect a little goodwill on the cheap. Nicely done, miss."
Chief"Kageaki... what are you thinking? You believe this is not a trap?"
Kageaki"I do not rule out the possibility that everything is exactly as stated."
Chief"Are you serious?"

Chief"Either we decline, choosing our words carefully, or we accept on the surface and do nothing in substance—in short, settle on sabotage. One of the two would be fitting, I submit, Your Highness."
舞殿宮"Hmm, true. Kageaki, you are fine with this, no?"
Kageaki"No."
舞殿宮"Ouch!?"
Chief"...Kageaki."

舞殿宮"No, no, no, that cannot be done..."
Chief"...What are you thinking? You believe this is not a trap?"
Kageaki"I do not rule out the possibility that everything is exactly as stated."
Chief"Are you serious?"
